name: gather-local
description: Read local documents and get a digest receipt for each one your assistant can cite.

workspace.title: Readable workspace
workspace.description: Local directory this profile may read. Choose only approved files.

allowed_origins.title: Allowed public HTTPS origins (optional)
allowed_origins.description: JSON array, for example ["https://example.com"]. Leave [] to deny public network access. Requests send model-selected paths and queries to these origins.

loopback_origins.title: Allowed local service origins (optional)
loopback_origins.description: JSON array, for example ["http://127.0.0.1:8080"]. Leave [] to deny local service access. Grant only services you intend the calling model to query.
